title: Malmgren on his deathbed: CIA and the Majestic tracked him
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Malmgren on his deathbed: CIA and the Majestic tracked him, about 1950s; told 2025 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: hospital on his deathbed, but he goes that was when the CIA started tracking me. They put my name in some file and he goes them and the Majestic.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a former presidential advisor named Harold Malmgren told him from a hospital bed near the end of his life that the CIA, the US spy agency, began tracking him in the 1950s. According to Michels, Malmgren said his name went into a file kept by the CIA and by the Majestic, a secret group some say has managed UFO matters. If true, it would mean a hidden UFO body was watching him for decades.
